spells.name: Corrupt
spells.description: Corrupt the organic internals of your target, causing intense pain over time.

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.description: Disrupts the earth surrounding the caster, injuring all those caught within range.

spells.name: Outburst
spells.description: Release a concentrated burst of fire at your target.

spells.name: Flame Strike
spells.description: Ignite your target with a burst of exceedingly hot flame.

spells.name: Fulmination
spells.description: Release an extremely painful explosion of energy.  This spell takes a moment to manifest.

spells.name: Greater Healing
spells.description: Heals a large amount of physical damage afflicted upon yourself or an ally.

spells.name: Lesser Healing
spells.description: Heals minor wounds which have been inflicted upon yourself or an ally.

spells.name: Lightning
spells.description: Calls forth a bolt of lightning upon your target, dealing a moderate amount of electrical damage.

spells.name: Magic Reflection
spells.description: Reflect the next spell cast on you back upon the caster.

spells.name: Mind Blast
spells.description: Injure your target

spells.name: Purify
spells.description: Cleanses a person or creature of persisting ailments.

spells.name: Spurt
spells.description: Launch a projectile of concentrated water.

spells.name: Thunderlash
spells.description: Unleash a large amount of electrical energy upon your target.

spells.name: Dispel Portal
spells.description: Dispel all portals in an area around the target.

spells.name: Ether Barrier
spells.description: Make target

spells.name: Ether Momentum
spells.description: Increase target!$s movement speed in the ether

spells.name: Etherworld Portal
spells.description: Open a portal from the etherworld to the world of the living, or from the world of the living to the etherworld.

spells.name: Expel Spirit
spells.description: Modify the Kau attack of your target so that it can be used to banish spirits

spells.name: Kau Regeneration
spells.description: Increase Kau regeneration rate of your target.

spells.name: Mental Healing
spells.description: Use the spirits to generate mana for anyone close to the target this can also be done from the ether.

spells.name: Mental Projectile
spells.description: Releases a concentrated beam of spirits that instantly drain Kau from your target

spells.name: Resurrect
spells.description: Return a spirit from the etherworld.

spells.name: Transcendental Awareness
spells.description: Target will be able to communicate with the dead beyond the ether and sense the living while in the ether.

spells.name: Transcendental Seance
spells.description: Summon restless spirits from the target in the etherworld

spells.name: Akh Bond
spells.description: Connect your akh with the akh of a pet. Part of the damage dealt to you will be dealt to the pet instead.

spells.name: Atrophy
spells.description: Fill the targets lungs with black smoke reducing its stamina regeneration and decreases creatures movement speed.

spells.name: Auw Surge
spells.description: Send out a wave of spirits that will hit anything between you and your target.

spells.name: Benumb Mind
spells.description: Break the targets concentration reducing mana regeneration and blocks creatures from using magic.

spells.name: Blind
spells.description: Blind your target.

spells.name: Cloud Of Ashes
spells.description: Summon a black sphere that blinds and slightly damages whoever is in it.

spells.name: Command Undead
spells.description: When cast on a target all undead you control will attack that target

spells.name: Control Undead
spells.description: Take control of an undead

spells.name: Crawling Hand
spells.description: Move all loot in an area around you closer to the target.

spells.name: Death Hand
spells.description: Drains health from your target and heals yourself.

spells.name: Mental Leech
spells.description: Drains mana from your target and replenishes your own

spells.name: Miasma
spells.description: Summon a thick poisonous smoke that damages any target within its area

spells.name: Mute
spells.description: Mutes your target.

spells.name: Raise Greater Walker
spells.description: Raise a mummy under your control

spells.name: Raise Strong Walker
spells.description: Raise a zombie under your control

spells.name: Raise Walker
spells.description: Raise a skeleton under your control

spells.name: Sacrificial Eruption
spells.description: All undead you control around the target will explode and deal damage.

spells.name: Sacrificial Heal
spells.description: Sacrifice all undead under your control to heal the target.

spells.name: Spider Boil
spells.description: Cover your target with small spiders that does damage over time.

spells.name: Summon Death Knight
spells.description: The next ritual stone used by the target will call forth a Death Knight.

spells.name: Summon Death Steed
spells.description: The next ritual stone used by the target will call forth a Death Steed.

spells.name: Summon Shade
spells.description: The next ritual stone used by the target will call forth a Shade.
